Empty state

Source: R/tier1-empty.R
shad_empty.Rd

A centred empty-state panel for "no data", search-miss, or 404 screens. Compose a media slot (icon or illustration), a title, a description, and an optional actions area.

Usage

shad_empty(
  title,
  description = NULL,
  media = NULL,
  media_variant = c("default", "icon"),
  content = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

title

The empty-state title.

description

Optional supporting text (may contain links/tags).

media

Optional shad_icon() name or a tag (icon, image, avatar) shown above the title.

media_variant

"icon" (rounded muted tile) or "default" (free-form illustration). Ignored when media is NULL.

content

Optional actions area — buttons, an input, links.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the root.

Value

An empty-state tag.

See also

Other shadshiny tier-1 components: shad_alert(), shad_aspect_ratio(), shad_avatar(), shad_badge(), shad_breadcrumb(), shad_button(), shad_button_group(), shad_card(), shad_code_block(), shad_item(), shad_kbd_group(), shad_label(), shad_progress(), shad_scroll_fade(), shad_separator(), shad_shimmer(), shad_skeleton(), shad_spinner(), shad_table(), shad_typography

Examples

shad_empty(
  "No projects yet",
  description = "Create your first project to get started.",
  media = "folder", media_variant = "icon",
  content = shad_button("New project")
)
